name: Joash (son of Ahaziah)
title: The Child King Saved from the Massacre
summary: Joash was king of Judah and the only survivor of King Ahaziah's sons after Queen Athaliah killed the rest of the royal family. He was hidden in the temple for six years by his aunt Jehosheba and the priest Jehoiada, and was crowned at the age of seven. His reign was marked by temple restoration, but after Jehoiada's death he turned to idol worship.

keyEvents.title: Saved from Athaliah's Massacre
keyEvents.description: As an infant, Joash was saved by his aunt Jehosheba when Queen Athaliah killed all the royal descendants to seize power.

keyEvents.title: Hidden in the Temple for Six Years
keyEvents.description: Joash was hidden in the house of the Lord with his nurse while Athaliah ruled over the land.

keyEvents.title: Crowned King at Seven Years Old
keyEvents.description: The priest Jehoiada organized a coup and crowned the seven-year-old Joash as king, while Athaliah was executed.

keyEvents.title: Restoration of the Temple
keyEvents.description: Joash ordered repairs to the house of the Lord and established a system with a collection box to fund the work.

keyEvents.title: Apostasy after Jehoiada's death
keyEvents.description: After the priest Jehoiada died, Joash allowed himself to be influenced by the leaders of Judah to abandon the Lord and worship Asherah poles and idols.

keyEvents.title: The murder of the prophet Zechariah
keyEvents.description: Joash ordered Zechariah, the son of the priest Jehoiada, to be stoned because he had prophesied against the king's apostasy. This was a cruel act of ingratitude toward the family that had saved his life.
